title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $79.80 on Shark Matrix Plus
excerpt: Post-Prime Day deals are still lingering.
content_html:
SAVE $79.80: As of Oct. 9, the Shark Matrix Plus is on sale for $199.99 at Amazon. That's a 25% discount on the list price.

Credit: Shark

$199.99 at Amazon
$279.79 Save $79.80

If you want to make it easier to keep your floors clean, a robot vacuum is a great upgrade. These handy gadgets take the hassle out of keeping your floors clean, with many models offering features such as self-emptying bins, smart mapping, and mopping capabilities. And as of Oct. 9, you can get a great deal on the Shark Matrix Plus at Amazon, which is now down to $199.99.

This is the best-ever price for this robot vacuum, so now's the time to buy.

This robot vacuum from Shark combines powerful suction with sonic mopping to tackle both dirt and tough stains across carpets and hard floors. Its Matrix Clean technology uses a precision grid pattern to make multiple passes over messes, and the CleanEdge Detect uses blasts of air and corner recognition to pull debris out from awkward edges and corners into its cleaning path.

And like some of the best models, it also has automatic dustbin emptying. The bagless base can hold up to 30 days' worth of dirt and debris. It also has a Recharge & Resume function. This lets the robot return to its base when the battery runs low, recharge, and then pick up where it left off.
